source.swatch_rgb: analytic sRGB of the spec colour rgba(0.2,0.5,0.9,1.0): round(255*c) = [51,128,230]. ovui 0.3.0 writes the colour model value straight to the framebuffer in sRGB, so the measured median equals this exactly (no conversion).
source.swatch_tol: max(12, 4 * measured jitter); measured per-channel jitter over 3 known-good renders was 0.0, so the band is the fixed floor of 12.
source.bbox: widget screen rects measured from 3 known-good renders of examples/good/panel.py (identical every time). The window is centred by ovui at 1280x720, so these are absolute screen coordinates for the fixed 420x360 window.
